contracts_rationale: Test-remediation/bug-fix mission (restore nightly suites #5987-#5991). No new interfaces, APIs, or externally visible events are introduced; changes are internal boundary/lock threading, test/oracle hardening, a derived artifact, a doc, and a perf import shave.
friendly_name: Nightly Suites Green — coord & charter rework fallout
purpose_context: After large internal reworks (the next coordination seam and the doctrine-to-charter cutover), the nightly escalated five P0 issues totalling 28 failing tests. This mission restores a green nightly by fixing one genuine ownership-boundary regression and realigning the remaining test/CI/doc/perf drift, preserving the red-CI-means-no-release discipline.
purpose_tldr: Return the nightly test suites to green after the coordination and charter reworks so the 4.0.0 release gate stays honest.
